They are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: General Manager
     

            
    



Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry Real Estate
Reporting To Managing Director / Board of Directors

Job Summary


	The General Manager will serve as the chief operating executive responsible for driving the company’s strategic vision, overseeing day-to-day business operations, managing key stakeholder relationships, and ensuring profitability and growth across all business lines.
	The ideal candidate will bring deep knowledge of the Nigerian real estate market, strong leadership capability, and a track record of delivering results in a structured yet dynamic business environment.


Key Responsibilities


	Define and execute the company’s short, medium, and long-term strategic objectives in alignment with the board’s vision.
	Identify new business opportunities, emerging markets, and investment prospects within the Nigerian real estate sector.
	Drive annual business planning, budgeting, and performance management processes. Operations Management
	Oversee all operational functions including property development, sales and leasing, facility management, and customer service.
	Establish and enforce policies, procedures, and quality standards across all departments.
	Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and take corrective action to ensure operational targets are met.
	Coordinate project timelines, contractor relationships, and delivery milestones for active development projects.
	Build and maintain productive relationships with government agencies including AGIS, FCDA, FCTA, and other relevant regulatory bodies.
	Facilitate land acquisition, title documentation, regulatory approvals, and compliance processes.
	Represent the company in industry associations, forums, and high-level business engagements.
	Manage relationships with clients, investors, joint-venture partners, and key contractors.


Qualifications


	Bachelor’s degree in Estate Management, Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
	Minimum of 10 years of professional experience, with at least 5 years in a senior management or general management role within the real estate sector.
	A Postgraduate Degree (MBA or MSc) in a relevant discipline is strongly preferred.
	Professional certifications such as ANIVS, NIS, PMP, or RICS will be an added advantage.
	Demonstrated experience in property development, sales, project management, and/or facility management.
	Proven track record of managing government stakeholder relationships and navigating regulatory environments in Abuja or comparable Nigerian cities.
	Experience managing multi-functional teams and cross-departmental operations.
	Strong business acumen with the ability to translate strategy into operational outcomes.
	Excellent leadership, negotiation, and interpersonal communication skills.
	Deep understanding of the Abuja real estate market, land tenure system, and property regulations.
	Proficiency in MS Office Suite and real estate management software.
	High integrity, discretion, and professional standards.
	Competitive and negotiable remuneration package commensurate with experience.
	Performance-based bonuses tied to company growth and individual KPIs.

title: Job Openings at Smollan
content:
Smollan - We are a global commerce solutions company. We work at the pivot point where retailer, brand owner and shopper intercept. We help our clients achieve faster and scalable growth through planning, executing, measuring and reporting on all aspects of commerce.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) GA Field Supervisor

Job Location: Nigeria

About the job
     

            
    




	As we continue to expand our presence, we are on the lookout for driven and unique individuals who are ready to make a significant impact and who are passionate about building an inclusive and diverse environment.
	You would play a crucial role in driving our expansion across Greater Africa and forming part of the evolutionary journey in these dynamic markets.
	This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the growth of a forward-thinking company that values innovation, collaboration, and a global perspective.


Requirements


	Degree, Higher or Basic Diploma in Sales & Marketing or relevant fields
	2- 3 years or more of experience in the FMCG Industry as a senior sales representative
	Essential / Minimum: 0-5 years|
	Sales Management
	People management
	Administration skills
	Account Management 
	Team Management
	Operational Excellence
	Operational Management
	Customer Service Skills
	Communication Skills (verbal & written).


Click here to apply online

 

 

2.) GA Brand Promoter

Job Location: Nigeria

About the job


	As we continue to expand our presence, we are on the lookout for driven and unique individuals who are ready to make a significant impact and who are passionate about building an inclusive and diverse environment.
	You would play a crucial role in driving our expansion across Greater Africa and forming part of the evolutionary journey in these dynamic markets.
	This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the growth of a forward-thinking company that values innovation, collaboration, and a global perspective.


Responsibilities
As a Brand Promoter, you will be responsible for: 


	Customer Service and Record Keeping
	Shelf Health and Maintenance
	Knowledge and Promotion of the Client’s Product.


Requirements


	Minimum of an OND qualification
	3 - 6 months of experience in Modern Trade Merchandising (supermarkets, hypermarkets, department stores, and other large-format retail stores).
	Must reside in Kano or Abuja
	Well-groomed and professional appearance
	Communication skills (verbal & written).


Click here to apply online

 

3.) GA Merchandizer

Job Location: Lagos

Responsibilities
As a Merchandiser, you will be responsible for:


	Customer/Client satisfaction
	Shelf Health and Administration
	Effective Teamwork and Self-Management


Requirements
To qualify for this role, you shoud have:


	3months of experience in Merchandising||Essential / Minimum|0-5 years|
	Grade D+ (D Plus) in Secondary Education
	Communication Skills
	Time Management Skills
	Customer Service Skills
	Planning and Organising Skills


Click here to apply online

Marketing / Sales Officer Job at Adkan Group and Services Limited




        
    

        
        Adkan Service Nigeria Limited is a wholly indigenous construction company with a bias of undertaking construction projects essentially within the country. The reason for this nationalistic and patriotic bent is to join hands with others of like minds in other specialised fields in making Nigeria not only the pride of other nations but a reference point in Architectural designs and brilliantly executed construction projects. In furtherance of this mission statement, it is worth stating that all our completed projects can stand the test of time and can also compete favourably with similar projects elsewhere in the world.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Marketing / Sales Officer
     

            
    



Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are seeking a results-driven and motivated Marketing / Sales Officer to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for promoting the company’s products and services, generating new business opportunities, developing client relationships, and driving sales growth.
	Candidates with previous experience working in a construction company or proven sales experience in the real estate industry are strongly encouraged to apply.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement effective marketing and sales strategies to achieve business targets.
	Identify and generate new leads through networking, referrals, digital marketing, field marketing, and other channels.
	Promote the company’s construction, property, and related services to prospective clients.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.
	Conduct property and project presentations to prospective clients.
	Follow up on leads, inquiries, quotations, proposals, and prospective customers.
	Identify new market opportunities and potential business partnerships.
	Conduct market research and monitor competitor activities and industry trends.
	Prepare sales reports, customer feedback, and regular updates on marketing activities.
	Work closely with management and other departments to ensure customer satisfaction and successful project acquisition.
	Meet or exceed assigned sales and business development targets.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree or HND in Marketing, Business Administration, Estate Management, Sales, or a related field.
	3 – 5 years of relevant experience in sales and marketing, preferably within a construction company or real estate industry.
	Proven ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
	Strong knowledge of sales and marketing techniques.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
	Good knowledge of the real estate and/or construction market is an added advantage.
	Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and achieve sales targets.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with digital marketing and social media platforms.
	Must be proactive, confident, target-oriented, and customer-focused.


Preferred Experience:
Candidates with any of the following backgrounds are particularly encouraged to apply:


	Sales / Marketing Officer in a construction company
	Real Estate Sales Executive/Agent
	Property Marketing Officer
	Business Development Officer in construction or real estate
	Building materials or construction-related sales


What We Offer


	Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
	Opportunities for career growth and professional development.
	A dynamic and performance-driven working environment.
	Opportunities to build valuable relationships within the construction and real estate sectors.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using“ Marketing / Sales Officer - Abuja”as the subject of the email.

Bookkeeper Job at MMT Consults




        
    

        
        MMT Consults is a dynamic Human Resource Consulting and General Services firm dedicated to delivering innovative, practical, and sustainable solutions that empower organizations to achieve excellence. We partner with businesses across diverse sectors to optimize their people, processes, and performance, ensuring growth, efficiency, and long-term success.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Bookkeeper

Job Location: Lifecamp, Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Bookkeeper to maintain accurate financial records and support the day-to-day accounting operations of our food and beverage business.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for recording financial transactions, monitoring sales and expenses, reconciling accounts, managing invoices and payments, and maintaining accurate records of inventory-related financial transactions.
	The role requires strong attention to detail, integrity, confidentiality, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced food and beverage environment.


Key Responsibilities


	Record daily sales, purchases, expenses, receipts, and other financial transactions accurately.
	Maintain and update accounting records, ledgers, and journals.
	Reconcile bank accounts, cash balances, POS records, and other financial accounts regularly.
	Monitor daily cash collections and ensure proper documentation and reconciliation.
	Prepare and process invoices, receipts, payment vouchers, and other financial documents.
	Track accounts payable and accounts receivable and follow up on outstanding balances.
	Maintain accurate records of supplier invoices and payments.
	Assist with payroll preparation and related financial records where required.
	Monitor food, beverage, packaging, and other operational expenses.
	Work with the operations/inventory team to reconcile stock records with financial records.
	Assist in monitoring food and beverage costs, wastage, stock variances, and cost of sales.
	Maintain proper records of purchases and supplier transactions.
	Assist with monthly closing activities and preparation of financial reports.
	Support the preparation of profit and loss statements, cash-flow reports, and other management reports.
	Ensure financial documents are properly filed and readily available for audit and review.
	Identify discrepancies, errors, unusual transactions, or potential losses and report them promptly.
	Ensure compliance with company financial policies, procedures, and applicable tax requirements.
	Assist management and the finance team with financial analysis and other accounting tasks as required.


Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess an OND with 1-2 years of experience.


Salary
N120,000 - N150,000 / Month.
